newsitem.title: USA: US Justice approves steel drum proposal.
newsitem.headline: US Justice approves steel drum proposal.

text.p: The U.S. Justice Department approved on Tuesday a proposal by steel drum manufacturer Russell-Stanley Corp to subcontract some of its business.
The department said the proposal would not be anti-competitive, because the company in its proposal said it would not subcontract to its competitors.
The move would allow Russell-Stanley to act as a prime contractor for customers who want to acquire all of their industrial steel drums from one source, the department said.

Russell-Stanley had said that the cost of transporting steel drums from its manufacturing plants in Texas and New Jersey to customers is sufficiently high as to limit the geographic area within which it can compete efficiently.
